subject: Fixing Beta to be the same between two copies in model with two likelihoods

messages.author: 57338e36f04c0bcf
messages.subject: Fixing Beta to be the same between two copies in model with two likelihoods
parts:
Hello, 

I was working on a model with two likelihoods: 

rw1rw1joint.formula <- as.formula(Y ~ -1 + beta0 + f(time.ILI, model='rw1', constr = F, hyper=c(0.01, 0.01)) +
                                    f(week.ILI, model='rw1', constr=T, hyper=c(0.01, 0.01)) + 
                                    f(time.phylo, w, copy = "time.ILI", fixed=FALSE, param = c(0, 0.001)) +
                                    f(week.phylo, w, copy='week.ILI', fixed=FALSE, param=c(0, 0.001)))

where time.phylo is a copy of time.ILI and week.phylo is a copy of week.ILI. I was wondering if it is possible to specify a constraint in INLA so that the Beta of time.phylo is the same as the Beta of week.phylo.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fixing Beta to be the same between two copies in model with two likelihoods
parts:
when using copy, the hyperparameters of 'idx' will also be copied. the
scaling infront of the copy, beta, can be controlled if there are more
copies, using the 'same.as' argument

f(i, model="iid") +
f(j, copy="i", hyper = list(beta = list(fixed=FALSE))) +
f(k, copy="i", same.as='j')


meanig that the 'beta' for the 'k' copy, is set to the same (as, point
to the same address) as as the 'beta' for the 'j' copy.

H
